integrity: Proved quartic and Schur-convexity analytically; exact SymPy and finite Paley examples independently replay basic identities; bounded literature comparison leaves historical equivalence risk.
scientific_limitations: Assumes existence of a skew-conference matrix of order n >= 8. Four strictly positive scalar loss weights only; no claim concerning other duals, larger erasure sets or unconstrained frame families. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Weighted four-erasure spectra and majorization rigidity for skew-conference frames
